crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the…
and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three…

people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
